channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: St Martin's rested hurlers for Leinster club football clash
item.description: The integrity of the Leinster club IFC was damaged last weekend when St Martin's opted not to field their dual stars against Tubberclair.

item.title: Thurles to host Munster club SHC final
item.description: FBD Semple Stadium will be the venue for the Munster club SHC final between Ballygunner and Éire Óg, Ennis.

item.title: Clifford releases his own clothing brand
item.description: In what is believed to be a first in the GAA, David Clifford has teamed up with McKeever Sports to launch his own brand of sports clothing.

item.title: 2026 Ladies National Football League fixtures revealed
item.description: Holders Kerry will begin the defence of their Lidl Ladies National Football League Division 1 crown with a glamour clash against TG4 All-Ireland champions Dublin on the opening weekend of the 2026 campaign.

item.title: Fulfil snack bars to sponsor All-Ireland U20HC
item.description: Fulfil snack bars are the new sponsors of the All-Ireland U20HC.

item.title: Third county calls on GAA to cut ties with Allianz
item.description: Fermanagh have joined neighbours Tyrone in backing Offaly's call on the GAA to end its 30-year association with Allianz.

item.title: Death of Down 1994 All-Ireland SFC winner Richard Starkey
item.description: Down football is mourning the passing of Richard Starkey, who won an All-Ireland SFC medal with the Mourne County in 1994.

item.title: Reel to double-job following Ardee appointment
item.description: Fergal Reel will combine the roles of Louth U20 and Ardee, St Mary's senior football managers in 2026.

item.title: Croker to host Leinster club finals double-header once again
item.description: Croke Park will once again host a double-header of Leinster club senior football and hurling finals next month.

item.title: Civic reception planned for Declan Hannon
item.description: A civic reception is in the pipeline for recently-retired Limerick hurling star Declan Hannon.
